_comment: Adeptus Mechanicus army-rule citations (10e). Doctrina Imperatives — the Command-phase pick that picks one of two pure-buff stances (Protector ranged, Conqueror melee). The 10e rule is buff-only; no penalty side. SwegHammer collapses 'until next Command phase' to 'for this round' since the round boundary aligns with both Command phases. Each imperative has an army-wide ranged/melee BS/WS bonus AND a sub-effect (Protector defensive -1 Hit melee, Conqueror +1 AP) that is gated on the BATTLELINE-or-within-6"-of-BATTLELINE proximity check — only 2 of 42 AdMech datasheets carry BATTLELINE (Skitarii Vanguard / Rangers), so the gated sub-effects fire on a much smaller subset of the army than the BS/WS portion.

simulator.doctrina_imperatives.quoted_text: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Doctrina Imperatives below. Until the end of the battle round, that Doctrina Imperative is active for your army, and all units from your army that have the Doctrina Imperatives ability gain the relevant abilities shown below. Protector Imperative: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability. Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. Conqueror Imperative: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
simulator.doctrina_imperatives.trigger: start of the battle round; the AdMech player selects one of Protector / Conqueror, active until the end of the battle round.
simulator.doctrina_imperatives.effect: Sets Army.doctrina_imperative to 'protector' or 'conqueror' for the round. In Unit.attack (faction-gated on Adeptus Mechanicus): Protector grants +1 to Hit on ranged attacks (improves Ballistic Skill by 1, army-wide) and, defensively, when an AdMech unit is the target of a melee attack the attacker takes -1 to Hit IF the AdMech target satisfies the BATTLELINE-or-within-6"-of-BATTLELINE proximity gate (helper `_doctrina_battleline_proximity_met`). Conqueror grants +1 to Hit on melee attacks (improves Weapon Skill by 1, army-wide) and +1 AP on all attacks IF the attacker satisfies the same BATTLELINE proximity gate. No penalty side: both Imperatives are buff-only in the published rule. Faction-gated so a non-AdMech unit in the same battle is unaffected. ADMECH-DIAG-2 (2026-05-24) introduced the proximity gate after the prior army-wide approximation was found to over-grant the gated sub-effects to ~95% of AdMech datasheets (only Skitarii Vanguard / Rangers carry BATTLELINE; the rest must be within 6" of one to receive the +1 AP / -1 defensive Hit).
